# Sehaj Varma

Sehaj Varma is an AI Automation Engineer and Backend Developer based in India, open to remote work worldwide. He builds LLM agents, RAG pipelines, Python automation suites, and Flask backends that turn manual workflows into reliable software. This index describes his personal portfolio at https://sehaj.wasmer.app/ — all pages are statically rendered HTML and open to automated access. A full markdown version of every page is available at [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## What Sehaj builds

- **LLM agents & RAG pipelines**: OpenAI and Gemini API integrations, prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture, conversational agents that call external APIs for real data instead of hallucinating.
- **Python automation**: private scripts for scheduled jobs, file processing, and API-to-API integrations — 10+ shipped, each turning a repeated manual step into a repeatable process.
- **Flask backends**: modular REST APIs on clean SQLite schemas, with input validation on every route and documentation good enough to read without asking questions.
- **Frontend & mobile**: accessible HTML/CSS/JS, plus Flutter/Dart (Provider-based state) — see Amai Yuki.

## Flagship project: Amai Yuki

- Cross-platform real-time messaging app: direct & group chats, a custom in-app camera module, Provider-based state architecture.
- Stack: Python/Flask REST backend on SQLite + Flutter/Dart frontend.
- The frontend is open-source and testable today; the backend is private but fully functional and documented.
- LLM features are layered into chat via prompt orchestration.

## Availability

- Currently available for: AI automation, Python backends, API integration, freelance projects, remote work worldwide.
- Response time: replies within a day, usually faster.

## FAQ

- Who is Sehaj Varma? An AI Automation Engineer and Backend Developer from India, open to remote work worldwide. He builds LLM agents, RAG pipelines, Python automation suites, and Flask backends.
- What does he specialize in? Workflow automation (Python scripts for scheduled jobs, file processing, API integration) and backend engineering (Flask REST APIs on clean SQLite schemas).
- What is Amai Yuki? His flagship project: a cross-platform real-time messaging app with direct and group chats, a custom camera module, and Provider-based state — Python/Flask backend with SQLite, Flutter/Dart frontend.
- What AI technologies does he work with? OpenAI and Gemini integrations, prompt orchestration, RAG architecture, and agents wired to external APIs.
- What is his tech stack? AI (OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, agents, prompt orchestration), Backend (Python, Flask, REST, SQLite), Automation (scripting, scheduled jobs, file processing, API integrations), Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS, Flutter, Dart), Deployment (Vercel, Netlify, Render, Wasmer).
- Is he available for freelance work? Yes — AI automation, Python backends, API integration, freelance projects. Contact mr.sehaj.official@gmail.com or github.com/mrsehajofficial.
